description: Tow truck regulated areas - Queensland is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. This dataset shows the boundaries of the Queensland tow truck regulated areas applicable to regulated towing services. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are maps and spatial data, transportation. It offers 2 resource(s) in shp, tab, fgdb, kmz, gpkg, xml. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
